title: The Parable of the Great Banquet
description: Jesus tells the parable about a man who holds a great banquet and invites many. When the meal is ready, those invited refuse with various excuses: one has bought a field, another five yoke of oxen, and a third has just gotten married. The master becomes angry and sends his servant out to bring in the poor, crippled, blind, and lame from the streets and alleys of the city, and then out to the roads and along the fences, so that the house will be full. None of those originally invited will get to taste his feast.

versions.title: The Parable of the Great Banquet
versions.description: Jesus tells the parable of a man who holds a great banquet, but the invited guests refuse to come with various excuses. The host then sends his servant out to bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame from the streets and alleys of the city, and afterward from the roads and along the fences, so that the house will be full.
